spec.title: Kamiwaza · Kubernetes Events & Stability
spec.description: Which pods in the platform namespace are failing or short of resources?

spec.title: Restarts (1h)
spec.description: Container restarts over the last hour

spec.title: OOM kills (1h)
spec.description: Containers restarted after an out-of-memory kill in the last hour

spec.expr: count(max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="$namespace", reason="OOMKilled"}) * on (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace"}[1h]) > 0)) or vector(0)

spec.title: Pending
spec.description: Pods waiting to be scheduled or started

spec.title: Failed pods
spec.description: Pods in the Failed phase, usually a Job that ran out of retries; they stay until deleted

spec.title: Image pull failures
spec.description: Containers that cannot pull their image

spec.title: Scrape targets down
spec.description: Kamiwaza metrics targets that failed their last scrape

spec.title: CPU, % of limit
spec.description: Busiest container per long-running workload right now

spec.expr: topk(10, 100 * max by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="cpu"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace="$namespace", owner_kind=~"ReplicaSet|StatefulSet|DaemonSet"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name!=""})))

spec.title: Memory, % of limit
spec.description: Largest container per long-running workload right now

spec.expr: topk(10, 100 * max by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="memory"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace="$namespace", owner_kind=~"ReplicaSet|StatefulSet|DaemonSet"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name!=""})))

spec.title: CPU throttling, top 10
spec.description: Share of CFS periods throttled, by workload and container

spec.expr: topk(10, 100 * max by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name, container) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace="$namespace", owner_kind=~"ReplicaSet|StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name!=""})))

spec.title: Restarts
spec.description: Container restarts over a sliding 30 minutes, by workload and container

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name, container) (round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace"}[30m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name!=""})) > 0)

spec.title: Node pressure
spec.description: Memory, disk, and PID pressure per node

spec.title: Volumes
spec.description: Persistent volume claims by utilisation (needs kubelet volume statistics)

spec.title: Warning events
spec.description: Kubernetes Warning events in the platform namespace

spec.title: Operator events
spec.description: Events the platform operator records on platform resources

options.content:
**Which pods in the platform namespace are failing or short of resources?**

- **Errors** counts restarts and out-of-memory kills in the last hour, and crash loops, pending pods, failed pods, and image pull failures now.
- **Saturation** shows the long-running workloads closest to their CPU and memory limits and the most throttled containers. One-shot Job pods are left out: their saturation is not actionable.
- **Nodes** shows memory, disk, and PID pressure over the time range.
- **Events** lists Kubernetes warnings and the operator's own events.
